basic_details.job_title: KVK Barmer 1 Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Stenographer, Programmer Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Barmer-1 (KVK Barmer 1) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 2 Stenographer Grade-III, Programmer Assistant T-4 Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline by sending the application form to the official address. The last date to submit the application is 30-08-2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years for all posts. Relaxation in Age to SC/ST/OBC candidates may be given in accordance with the orders issued by Govt. of India from time to time.

qualification.education_qualification: 12th Class pass or equivalent from a recognized Board or University, Bachelor's degree in Agriculture or any other branch of science/social science relevant to agriculture or equivalent qualification from a recognized University with two years experience
qualification.details: Stenographer Grade-III: 12th Class pass or equivalent from a recognized Board or University. Professional Efficiency: Dictation test in English or Hindi at 80 w.p.m. for 10 minutes with transcription in 50/65 minutes on computer. Programmer Assistant (Lab. Technician) T-4: Bachelor's degree in Agriculture or any other branch of science/social science relevant to agriculture or equivalent qualification from a recognized University with two years experience in the relevant subject/post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level-4 Rs. 25500/- and Pay Level-6 Rs. 35400/- in 7th CPC
salary_details.details: Stenographer Grade-III: Pay Level-4 Rs. 25500/- in 7th CPC Programmer Assistant (Lab. Technician) T-4: Pay Level-6 Rs. 35400/- in 7th CPC

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.barmer1.kvk2.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.barmer1.kvk2.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KVK Barmer 1 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Stenographer Grade-III and Programmer Assistant T-4 posts is 30th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for KVK Barmer 1 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Stenographer Grade-III and Programmer Assistant T-4 positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Stenographer Grade-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th Class or equivalent from a recognized board and possess professional efficiency in dictation and transcription.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Programmer Assistant T-4?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Agriculture or any relevant science/social science branch with two years of experience is required for this post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 30 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for KVK Barmer 1 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for KVK Barmer 1 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Screening Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Stenographer Grade-III will be paid as per Pay Level-4 (Rs. 25500/-) and Programmer Assistant T-4 as per Pay Level-6 (Rs. 35400/-) in the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in Offline mode by sending the application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website www.barmer1.kvk2.in, and links are provided in the Important Links section.
